quote: WEG announces an investment plan of approximately R$ 543 million to increase transformer production capacity in Brazil. The investments will be made over the next two years in manufacturing units located in Minas Gerais and Rio Grande do Sul. In Minas Gerais, the Company will invest approximately R$ 370 million, expanding its power transformer factory in the city of Betim by nearly 24,000 m²… In Rio Grande do Sul, the factory located in the city of Gravataí will receive an investment of approximately R$ 128 million…
